user.title: Météo France vigilance
user.description: An API key from the Météo France public portal is required, subscribed to the « Données Publiques Vigilance » service.

data_description.api_key: The application key shown on portail-api.meteofrance.fr, under your « DonneesPubliquesVigilance » subscription. Only needed for mainland departments.
data_description.departments: One or more mainland department codes. Coastal areas can be typed in directly (3010, 6410…). Leave empty to follow the overseas territories only.
data_description.maps: The two national thumbnails, today and tomorrow, published as image entities. Mainland only.
data_description.scan_interval: The bulletin is reissued at 06:00 and 16:00, and corrected in between when the situation worsens.
data_description.basins: Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana, Réunion, Mayotte, Saint Martin and Saint Barthélemy. No key is needed for these territories: their data comes from the Météo France vigilance website rather than the public API — Météo France publishes none for the overseas territories. This access is not contractual and may change without notice.

reauth_confirm.title: Météo France key refused
reauth_confirm.description: The key is no longer accepted — it may have expired. Enter a new one to resume updates.

reconfigure.title: Replace the API key
reconfigure.description: The new key is checked against Météo France before being saved. Departments and entities are left untouched.

error.cannot_connect: Météo France did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
